circle.data-tooltip-text: c is a copy of the caller's value
c goes out of scope
s acquires ownership of a resource
s's resource is immutably borrowed by r; s is read-only while the borrow is live
s is live in a conditional expression
s's resource is moved
s was moved in at least one branch above, so it can't be used after the branches. If the branch that ran didn't move it, its resource is dropped when s goes out of scope.
s's resource is no longer immutably borrowed

g.data-tooltip-text: s goes out of scope. Its resource is dropped here only if no branch above moved it (Rust tracks this with a runtime drop flag).

g.data-tooltip-text:
• the resource r points to is immutably borrowed by println!
• println! reads from r through an implicit reference, so r isn't moved
• println! no longer borrows the resource r points to
• r's immutable borrow ends

• u is live in a conditional expression
• u's resource is moved into drop, which drops it

• u is live in a conditional expression
• u was moved in at least one branch above, so it can't be used after the branches (until it's assigned again). If the branch that ran didn't move it, its resource is dropped when u goes out of scope.
• u's resource is no longer mutably borrowed

g.data-tooltip-text: u goes out of scope. Its resource is dropped here only if no branch above moved it (Rust tracks this with a runtime drop flag).

g.data-tooltip-text:
• the resource q points to is mutably borrowed by push through q; q can't be used while the borrow is live
• push reads and writes through q (mutable reborrow — q can't be used until push returns)
• push no longer borrows the resource q points to
• q's mutable borrow ends
